result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual clipping problem.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen, and its name is truncated mid-word. This suggests the horizontal scroll container is not properly indicating that it's scrollable, and the card is partially hidden without a clear affordance for the user to scroll.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontally scrollable list has a visible scroll indicator or a clear peek of the next card to signal scrollability. Also make sure restaurant names are truncated with an ellipsis rather than being clipped mid-character.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is clipped at the bottom of the screen without any visual indication that there is more content below. While this may be intentional to hint at scrollability, the abrupt cut-off may feel unpolished.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade or gradient at the bottom of the list to indicate more content is available below, improving the visual hierarchy and scroll affordance.
